item.title: ▫️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29798

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
▫️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces tighten the encirclement around the AFU formations in the north-east of Kharkov region and expand the external control zone.
💥
Fights are underway in the encirclement for the liberation of Varvarovka, Lobanovka, and Reznikovo (Kharkov region). Moreover, enemy formations are being destroyed near Nikolayevka, Nefedovka, Kupino, and Chernoye in Kharkov region.
▪️
In the encirclement, the enemy lost up to 35 troops and an armoured fighting vehicle during the day.
👉
While expanding the external control zone, Russian troops are operating to liberate Prikolotnoye and Sosnovy Bor in Kharkov region
. Strikes are delivered at enemy strongholds in Khatneye and Fedorovka (Kharkov region).
🚩
Moreover, as a result of resolute offensive actions
, Russian troops took control over Novaya Kazachaya in Kharkov region.
💥
Strikes were delivered
at manpower and materiel of a mechanised brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a national guard brigade near Slatino, Sosnovka, Velikiy Burluk, Metallovka, Russkiye Tishki, and Bezruki (Kharkov region).
🔥
In Sumy region
, strikes were delivered at formations of two airmobile brigades, two mechanised brigades of the AFU, two territorial defence brigades, and one national guard regiment near Doroshovka, Rudnevka, Khoten, Ivolzhanskoye, Nikolskoye, Bititsa, and Lipnyak (Sumy region).
▪️
In total, the enemy lost over 250 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, 19 motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations in the area of responsibility of the Sever Group of Forces.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line
. Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the AFU and a territorial defence brigade near Sobolevka, Chervony Oskol, Grushevka, and Andreyevka (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 220 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, and 14 motor vehicles.
↗️
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions
. Formations of a mechanised brigade, an airmobile brigade, a motorised infantry brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a territorial defence brigades have been hit near Slavyansk, Kramatorsk, Vasilevskaya Pustosh, and Nikolayevka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy has lost more than 195 troops, 18 motor vehicles, and a Polish-made 155-mm Krab self-propelled artillery system.
👉
See Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 3 October 2026
Part 2 (
👉
see Part 1
)
↗️
The Tsentr Group's units improved the tactical situation.
Russian units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, and two national guard brigades close to Svyatogorovka, Belozerskoye, Verovka, Blagodat, Druzhkovka, and Roganskoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
📍
In Dobropolye (Donetsk People's Republic), assault groups of the 51st Army along with marine units, led an offensive in the north-western, eastern, and central parts of the city.
Units of the 76th Air Assault Division wiped out enemy position and seized a section of a treeline.
Over the past 24 hours, 70 buildings have been liberated and more than 20 militants of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been neutralised.
▪️
In total, up to 385 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, seven motor vehicles, one 155-mm Bogdana self-propelled artillery system, and three electronic warfare stations have been neutralised in the area of responsibility of the Tsentr Group of Forces.
📍
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence
. Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of an assault brigade, an air assault brigade, an assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and a marine brigade close to Mirolyubovka, Kolomiytsy, Ivanovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), and Kirovo (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 240 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, and four motor vehicles.
↗️
The Dnepr Group of Forces' units took more advantageous lines and positions
. Formations of a mechanised brigade and a mountain assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine have been hit near Orekhov, Veselyanka, and Kushugum (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
More than 35 troops and 12 motor vehicles were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces
have inflicted damage on storage areas of unmanned aerial vehicles as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 149 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems
shot down six guided aerial bombs and 680 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊
In total
, since the beginning of the special military operation,
the AFU losses amounted to:

674

tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,784
MLRS combat vehicles,
▫️
36,614
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
73,481
units of support military vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
